items.q: Will these questions help me clear an interview?
items.a: They help you revise concepts and answer clearly. Interviews also test your projects and thinking, so prepare real examples with numbers as well.

items.q: How many questions are there and what topics?
items.a: 160 questions across SEO, ads, GA4 and HR, with a quiz to test yourself.

items.q: Is the interview prep tool free?
items.a: Yes. The interview prep and quiz tool is free to use as often as you like, with no sign-up or login.
